HANDLING AND EXCEPTION INSTRUCTIONS

NORMAL USE

  1. Use this reusable card only for the item and quantity shown.
  2. Scan before triggering replenishment or making a physical handoff.
  3. Confirm the card displayed on screen before accepting the action.
  4. Keep the card with its designated container or Kanban location.

DO NOT

  • Do not write over, duplicate, or photocopy the QR code.
  • Do not use a damaged, obsolete, blocked, or replaced card.
  • Do not use the reusable card as a pallet identity tag.
  • Do not create manual ERP transactions to bypass a blocked signal.
IF LOST, DAMAGED, DUPLICATED, WRONG ITEM, WRONG QUANTITY, OR SCAN IS REJECTED:
Stop the movement, isolate the card/material, and contact the production supervisor. Resolve the exception digitally before continuing.
